layer_map.scope: DS-V4.1-Flash and Qwen3.8-27B full-attention control; zero-based source layer pairs are not established by the retained intake excerpts.

released_dfly2.evidence: research/deep-dives/intake-nov26-kernels/angel.md: DFly2 reads paired target MLA latents; DS/GLM weights and train configs reported released, DS/GLM vLLM support future at that revision.

ds_v41_flash.verdict: UNRESOLVED: no retained pair-level mapping and runtime identity witness; empty supported_pairs means no pair established, not proof no pair exists.
ds_v41_flash.unsupported: Any pair without a demonstrated matching source layer, latent representation and lifecycle is not eligible for direct aliasing.

qwen38_27b.verdict: REJECT direct DFly2 MLA alias into local full-attention K/V; the existing DFlash2 hidden-state extraction IDs are not KV layer pairs. A separately designed adapter is unqualified.
qwen38_27b.unsupported: Gated-delta/recurrent layers are not full-attention KV layers and are outside this comparison.

kv_stride.local_full_attention: Per-layer K and V allocations [GQA width, kv_size, stream]; non-transposed K/V position stride ggml_row_size(dtype, respective GQA width), stream stride ggml_row_size(dtype, width * kv_size). V may instead be transposed, in which case its position dimension is first and these V position strides do not apply. MLA allocates K but no separate V in this implementation.
kv_stride.dtype: Runtime selectable; recorded 27B trace compares target f16/q8_0/q4_0 with drafter f16 (handoffs/active/speculative-decoding.md:381-382). Model Q8_0 weights do not imply KV dtype.
kv_stride.comparison: Matching sizes alone cannot establish aliasing: dtype, quantization blocks, latent meaning, layout, sequence/slot addressing and ownership must match. Actual runtime row sizes and DFly2 reader strides are not retained here.

selection_epoch.released_rule: Selections from each paired target indexer for the last accepted token are read for the next draft block, alongside draft-block positions; see research/deep-dives/intake-nov26-kernels/angel.md and intake-digests/2026-11-26-ids-2982-3005.md:567-575.
selection_epoch.ds_v41_flash: The retained handoff describes top-512 compressed rows plus a raw local window, and eight index-source layers with reuse (handoffs/active/deepseek-v41-flash-evaluation.md, DS41-C123.1 and DS41-C7.2). It does not establish a DFly2 reader's per-slot epoch or accepted-token alignment.
selection_epoch.qwen38_27b: Local full-attention control has no demonstrated DFly2 sparse index selection to reuse. DFlash2 selector top-k in common/speculative.cpp is a token selector, not evidence of a target sparse-position index.
selection_epoch.required_identity: Bind selection to target model/config revision, target source layer, sequence and slot generation, last accepted absolute position, and current KV generation; invalidate or recompute after rollback or slot recycling. This is a required contract, not an observed implementation.

rollback_owner.observed_local: Server owns target and draft sequence cleanup/checkpoint operations separately (tools/server/server-context.cpp at ffc1bac82, including lines 308-310, 2403-2406, 3543-3545, 3936-3939, 4232-4234). DFlash accept callback is a no-op (common/speculative.cpp:1770); its encoder injects features into the separate draft context. This is not an implemented DFly2 shared-cache lifecycle.
rollback_owner.required_shared_state: Target/server remains sole owner of KV lifetime and rollback; drafter has a read-only view and must discard selection/address references when the accepted prefix or slot generation changes. No retained DFly2/local integration proves this invariant.

ds_v41_flash_released_dfly2.accept: UNRESOLVED: last-accepted selection rule is documented, but pair/stride/epoch binding is unwitnessed.
ds_v41_flash_released_dfly2.reject: UNRESOLVED: no witness that rejected suffix and its indices are invalidated before next read.
ds_v41_flash_released_dfly2.slot_reuse: UNRESOLVED: no slot-generation and stale-index invalidation witness.

qwen38_27b_full_attention_released_dfly2.accept: REJECT direct alias: released MLA reader and local separate full-attention K/V have no demonstrated common ABI.
qwen38_27b_full_attention_released_dfly2.reject: REJECT direct alias: representation mismatch and no shared rollback/selection witness.
qwen38_27b_full_attention_released_dfly2.slot_reuse: REJECT direct alias: representation mismatch and no shared slot-generation witness.
